::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 27th 1894  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 206-7
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)
I cannot at all tell whether this is the right length, as the only ‘Golden Treasuries’ I have seen are my own and I do not think they have introductions.[^1]

I can easily add biographical details if you wish it to be longer - but I like to write to my own sense of the needs of the subject and to add or diminish afterwards as required.

Do you know whether [Mrs Ritchie](people/person_1240.qmd) is abroad. I was moved to write to her by sympathy with her [preface](other_books/otherbook_688.qmd) to Miss Mitford, and I have never had an answer

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY's *A Book of Golden Deeds*, *A Book of Worthies* and *The Story of the Christians and the Moors in Spain* all appeared in Macmillan's Golden Treasury Series.  CMY was presumably working on her introduction to the Golden Treasury edition of *The Christian Year*.
